verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first financial infrastructure platform, so official SDKs are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only mentions APIs, components, webhooks and an 'Explore the API' link. It never names any official SDK or client library, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
